name: Ca'ron Williams
strengths: Williams plays island off-man with a clean cushion and a low athletic platform: ready feet that stay balanced before the pedal.
Williams shows fluid hip transition in the backpedal and keeps eyes inside on the quarterback while shadowing the receiver.
Williams brings a lean 5-11 / 6-0 length frame with long arms that disrupt windows, plus press flashes when the call asks.
Williams finishes with ball production: 2025 taped 3 INT (1 pick-six), 4 PBU, and 47 tackles; open-field return juice shows once he has the ball.
weaknesses: Williams is still filling out a lean 170-ish frame: White's press/man room will want more mass and consistent press strength at the LOS.
comparison: Williams comps to Derek Stingley Jr. - lean ~6-0 cover corner mold with length, fluid hips, and ball skills (size-matched to Williams' 5-11 / 6-0 / ~170-175 listing).
projection: Williams projects as a Year 2 CB contributor in nickel/boundary packages who can compete for a starting job by Year 3. Ceiling: every-down SEC length corner with filled-out mass on a 5-11 / 6-0 frame.
schemeFit: Williams fits Brad White length-first CB who can live off the hash in pattern-match / off-man and grow into press technique as the frame fills.
